rulings.why: A real conditional step to the player's own weapon damage die; no manufactured-weapon stepDie lane exists, so a strikeDamage star is the honest delivery.

Weapon familiarity is real (bola/sap/whip are all martial in core.json), but the applier's situational branch fires FIRST and would drop the proficiency grant silently — the lane grant must ship alone.
COMPANION_MODS consumes 'eidolon' (companions.ts:785) and hulking-size/gigantic-megafauna-companion are the exact note-only precedents.
A standing change to the player's own ranged attack math; far-throw, shootists-edge and masterful-hunter already carry range-increment stars in the same lane.

Constant truesight is a real permanent sense, but the judge under-granted: 'truesight' is already a live sense name in core.json (patron-reborn) and senseLabel title-cases any name, so see-invisibility is not needed.
Verified: 'gadget' appears nowhere in src/rules or src/sheet, so there is no resource for resourceMaxSet to target — needsEngineWork is accurate for a real per-day player resource.
Verified: snareAllowance() takes only craftingRank and hardcodes 4/6/8 with no feat hook, so a displayed daily number is wrong for this feat.
Verified: build.ts only sets an all-repertoire signature list from the summoner's unlimited-signature-spells class feature (build.ts:1768-1771); no record field exists.
usesUpgrade is the existing lane and the target feat really carries limitedUses {max:1,per:'day'}, so the applier's guard passes and 'hour' is a legal unit.
A change to the player's own companion delivered through COMPANION_MODS kind 'animal', which deriveAnimalCompanion consumes; note-only riders are established (loyal-warhorse, stealthy-companion).
maxHpBonus is read by featHpBonus/deriveMaxHp and +10 is the feat's own delta over the heritage's printed 10 — encoding 14 would bury the separate heritage-record gap inside the feat.
Verified: derive.ts:1926 subtracts the worn armor's speed penalty from every Speed with no feat check, and speedPenalty only ADDS — the sheet's Speed is simply wrong for a dwarf with this feat.
senses takes free-text names with range/acuity (wavesense, magicsense, deathsense all ship that way), so motion-sense 30 ft imprecise is exactly expressible.
Kind 'animal' is consumed by deriveAnimalCompanion, so the note reaches the companion card; void healing has no IWR lane, making note-only the correct delivery.

The record carries untrainedProficiency but untrainedSkillBonus (derive.ts:305-315) has no level scaling, so every untrained skill is 1 low at 5th and 2 low at 7th+ — a real numeric defect with no data shape.
A standing player-side degree-of-success upgrade on saves; iron-lung is the identical entry already in the registry.

Confirmed the guardians-armor class feature carries no resistances field, so nothing anywhere gives this physical resistance; ModeDef.resistances accepts formula strings (@actor.level tokens already ship).
A permanent defensive rule on the player's own AC; sturdy-neck-stock and talonstrike-blade are the same off-guard/AC star shape.
All five base ids verified in core.json and duskwalker-weapon-familiarity carries byte-identical critSpecWeapons.bases — critSpec is properly scoped, so no every-weapon over-grant.
Verified unarmedTraits is unarmed-only and no lane adds a trait to a manufactured weapon; the record is a real permanent change to the player's wielded weapons.
The judge's premise is false — 'red-mantis-assassin-dedication' IS in CASTER_ARCHETYPES (casterArchetypes.ts:152), so the archetype entry id exists and occult-breadth already ships this exact shape.
Verified: ELEMENT_BLAST (derive.ts:1525) pins one damage type per element and deriveBlastStrikes offers no alternative, so the chosen type can never be shown.
Verified: build.ts:1875 pins the font to {type: build.divineFont}; the 'allowed' list exists only for the hardcoded battle font, so half this cleric's font slots render as the wrong spell.

Nothing consumes it: kinds.includes() is only ever tested for 'animal' and 'eidolon' (companions.ts:428/466/785), so a 'follower' mod is dead data, and follower records carry only prose with no quality tier to raise.
A permanent crit rider on the player's own granted fangs Strike; artery-map carries the identical '1d6 persistent bleed' strikeDamage star.
unarmedTraits {match,add,stepDie} is the right lane and cannot double-grant, though it stays inert until ratfolk's missing Sharp Teeth jaws Strike is added to the ancestry record.

It grants a 2-action activity resolved at the table whose extra damage lands on the target — every player-side action grant in this same pool was ruled NEEDS_NOTHING, and no COMPANION_MODS entry carries an activity.
Identical text to additional-servings, which carries the same resourceMaxSet; build.ts:2667 applies resourceFloors by resource id regardless of class.
+1d6 spirit on the player's own damage against a designated creature — the oathbow entry is the same vow-scoped strikeDamage star.
A permanent movement capability marked on the Stride action record; feather-step is the established RECORD_MARKERS precedent and 'stride' exists in core.actions.
Verified: the apparition repertoire is built only from each apparition option's grantedSpells (build.ts:1825), so no feat field can add Animal Form and the player cannot cast it.
The fix is byte-identical to halo's innateSpells entry and core.spells.light exists, so the referential guard passes.
A toggleable self-buff with a gate that exists; 'damage' is a legal ModeTargetKind and appliesWhen keeps the +4 status off ranged Strikes rather than over-granting.
Both action records exist in core.actions and eclipsed-vitality already marks avoid-notice/sneak/hide — this is the lane's purpose, not an unmodelled activity.
Marks the player's own Stride and Swim; feather-step ('you can Step into difficult terrain') is the exact precedent for terrain notes in RECORD_MARKERS.
A standing change to how the player Strides, on an action record that exists; feather-step precedent.
Same Stride-marker lane, and the cursebound gate rides in the marker's value field, which the applier supports.
resurgent-maelstrom and improvisational-defender carry these two exact stars already, so the lane and the wording are both established.
Eight sibling capstones (eternal-boost, panache-paragon, perfect-readiness, full-automation…) carry the identical quickened condition marker; 'quickened' exists in core.conditions.

Both halves are 'use the other number the sheet already prints' — the same pool ruled twirl-through and unified-theory NEEDS_NOTHING for exactly that, and the Conceal an Object half is a DC another creature rolls against.
